contexts.text: The particulars are to be related.
To make mention of (or commemorate commemorare) the name of Jehovah () = to worship from the goods of love and truths of faith.
To make mention of His name () = to instruct as to what His quality is.
Otherwise such things would not have been mentioned.
These are things too slight to be mentioned in the most holy Word.

Ye shall not mention the name of other gods () = that we are not to think from the doctrine of falsity... To mention = to think... because to mention is of the mouth; and by the things which are of the mouth are signified the things which are of thought. Explained.
It has been conceded to mention such things...
The Angels say. All these things which you have mentioned...
I have scarcely believed that this is worthy to be mentioned.
I wanted to mention it, but could not...
